== Amyrlin and Keeper networks ==

There's a line that says "Presumably Elaida, Alviarin Freidhen and Tarna Feir all have access to the full Amyrlin's and Keeper's networks. " I don't know about that...how would Elaida and Alviarin know? Did they torture it out of Siuan and Leane? I suppose the reports could come in via carrier pigeon addressed to the position of Amyrlin and Keeper rather than the person, but that conflicts with the information in the previous paragraph that says "When Siuan Sanche was deposed and stilled, she maintained control of the Amyrlin's Eyes-and-Ears..."
Either way, should we take the first line I mentioned out now that Alviarin has disappeared, Tarna isn't Keeper, and Elaida is Suffa? [[User:Seebster|Seebster]] 04:45, February 19, 2011 (UTC)

== Methods and Signals ==

Would it be fitting to have a section on methods of communication for the Aes Sedai spy agents? We know about the Yellow Ajah's signal of herbs over a door, certain code words Nynaeve and Siuan have used to confirm the spy. Do we know more? How about the use of carrier pigeons to relay information? Anyone want to have a go at that? [[User:Seebster|Seebster]] 04:58, February 19, 2011 (UTC)
